newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Baltic shipping council to set up Singapore office.
newsitem.headline: Baltic shipping council to set up Singapore office.

text.p: Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said on Monday it has granted approval for the Baltic and International Maritime Council (BIMCO) to establish a representative office.
BIMCO is an international shipping association with its headquarters in Denmark.
BIMCO said the new office aims at maintaining close dialogue among its Asian members as well as to enhance the profile of the Association.

"BIMCO's decision to establish a presence in Asia reflects the growing importance of shipping in Asia and the increasing number of BIMCO members in Asia," Finn Frandsen, secretary general of BIMCO, said in a statement.

BIMCO's board of Directors include representatives from Hanjin Shipping Co Ltd, Mitsui O.S.K Lines, Nippon Yusen Kaisha, Dongnama Shipping Co Ltd, Neptune Orient Lines and Regional Container Lines (Pte) Ltd.
